论有限内存下的语言生成On Language Generation in the Limit with Bounded Memory

Jon Kleinberg Anay Mehrotra Cornell University Stanford University kleinberg@cornell.edu anaymehrotra1@gmail.com Amin Saberi Grigoris Velegkas Stanford University Google Research amin.saberi@gmail.com gvelegkas@google.com
摘要Abstract

我们在有限记忆的限制下研究语言生成。 在此任务中，学习者一次观察一个未知目标语言的示例，并且最终必须仅输出来自目标的新的有效示例。We study language generation in the limit under bounded memory. In this task, a learner observes examples from an unknown target language one at a time and must eventually output only new valid examples from the target.

现有的工作假设学习者可以访问整个示例历史记录，这是一个强有力的假设，因为在现实资源限制下运行的算法只能保留有关过去的有限信息。学习理论中的大量工作表明，记忆限制可以极大地改变可学习的内容。我们将这一工作范围扩展到语言生成的极限。Existing work assumes the learner has access to the entire example history which is a strong assumption, since algorithms operating under realistic resource constraints can retain only limited information about the past. A large body of work in learning theory shows that memory constraints can dramatically change what is learnable; we extend this line of work to language generation in the limit.

首先，我们首先研究不记得过去例子的生成器。 我们证明，在对枚举的轻微限制下，即使没有记忆，每个可数的无限语言集合仍然是可生成的。 如果没有这个限制，我们将给出何时可以进行无记忆生成的准确表征。然后，我们转向有限集合的定量覆盖保证，描述无记忆生成器可实现的最佳极小极大密度——针对给定大小的任何集合可以保证的最佳密度。这个极小极大界是组合的，依赖于斯佩纳定理和对称链分解。 我们进一步表明，为学习者提供最后一个的滑动窗口First, we first study generators that remember no past examples. We show that under a mild restriction on the enumeration, every countable collection of infinite languages remains generable even with no memory. Without this restriction, we give an exact characterization of when memoryless generation is possible. We then turn to quantitative coverage guarantees for finite collections, characterizing the optimal minimax density achievable by memoryless generators — the best density one can guarantee against any collection of a given size. This minimax bound is combinatorial and relies on Sperner’s theorem together with symmetric chain decompositions. We further show that giving the learner a sliding window of the lastWW示例并没有改善这种最坏情况的密度，而允许它存储examples does not improve this worst-case density, whereas allowing it to storebb自适应地选择过去的例子严格提高了每个可实现的密度adaptively chosen past examples strictly improves the achievable density for everyb≥1b\geq 1.

最后，我们重新审视极限识别，这是学习者必须收敛到目标语言的单一正确假设的经典任务。 我们专注于其经过充分研究的增量变体，学习者只记得之前的猜测。 在这里，尽管精确识别在仅包含三种语言的集合上已经失败，但我们表明，对于每个有限集合，仅需要收敛到目标的“近似”版本即可实现温和的松弛。 总之，这些结果表明，有界内存对这三个任务的影响不同：每个可数集合的生成仍然是可实现的，而密度和识别仅限于有限集合，并且随着集合的增长，保证会减弱。Finally, we revisit identification in the limit, the classical task where the learner must converge to a single correct hypothesis for the target language. We focus on its well-studied incremental variant, where the learner remembers only its previous guess. Here, although exact identification already fails on a collection of just three languages, we show that a mild relaxation, which only requires convergence to an “approximate” version of the target, is achievable for every finite collection. Together, these results show that bounded memory affects the three tasks differently: generation remains achievable for every countable collection, while density and identification are confined to finite collections, with guarantees that weaken as the collection grows.

1 简介Introduction

长期以来，对语言学习方式进行建模一直让理论计算机科学家着迷，这个方向的核心形式模型之一是Modeling how languages are learned has long fascinated theoretical computer scientists, and one of the central formal models in this direction is有限的语言识别language identification in the limit [14, 2, 3]。 在此任务中，给定未知目标语言的正枚举，学习者重复输出该语言本身的假设，如果这些假设最终稳定在正确的目标语言上，则学习器成功。 事实证明，这一要求相当严格：Angluin 的. In this task, given a positive enumeration of an unknown target language, the learner repeatedly outputs a hypothesis for the language itself and succeeds if these hypotheses eventually stabilize on the correct target language. This requirement turns out to be quite stringent: Angluin’s[3]结果表明，只有非常有限的语系才能实现识别，甚至排除了简单的无限集合，例如常规语言。results show that identification is achievable only for very limited language families, ruling out even simple infinite collections such as the regular languages.

这种语言识别模型本身的部分动机是人类如何从正面例子中获取语言的问题。基于这个观点，This model of language identification was itself motivated in part by the question of how humans acquire language from positive examples. Building on this perspective,[24]研究表明，如果削弱学习者从识别目标语言到showed that if one weakens the learner’s goal from identifying the target language to生成generating从中获得新的正确示例（更接近任务的现实要求），问题变得更加容易处理。fresh correct examples from it (which is closer to the real-world requirements of the task), the problem becomes significantly more tractable.

他们称这种较弱的要求为They termed this weaker requirement语言生成受到限制。language generation in the limit.更具体地说，修复无限语言的可数集合More concretely, fix a countable collection of infinite languagesℒ={ℒ1,ℒ2,…}\euscr{L}=\left\{L_{1},L_{2},\ldots\right\}在可数域上over a countable domain𝒳\euscr{X}。对手选择目标语言. It then outputs a new stringyty_{t}它的目标是经过一段有限的时间and its goal is that after some finite timet⋆t^{\star}每个输出every outputyty_{t}在于lies inK∖StK\setminus S_{t}. [24]表明这个较弱的任务是可能的showed that this weaker task is possible for每个every可数的语言集合。 这两个结果之间形成鲜明对比。 在这两种设置中，学习者都会收到相同的信息：积极的信息流 目标语言的示例。 唯一的区别在于它必须产生什么。 然而，这种差异会产生巨大的后果： 识别仅适用于高度 可数语言的有限族，而生成是可能的 他们所有人。countable collection of languages. The contrast between these two results is stark. In both settings, the learner receives the same information: a stream of positive examples from the target language. The only difference is what it must produce. Yet, this difference has dramatic consequences: Identification is possible only for highly restricted families of countable languages, while generation is possible for all of them.

这种鲜明的对比提出了一个自然的问题：在生成器的任务变得像识别一样困难之前，我们还能对生成器提出多少要求？随后的一系列工作通过引入中间概念来探索这一点，其中学习者必须覆盖目标语言的“密集”子集This stark contrast raises a natural question: how much more can we demand of a generator before its task becomes as hard as identification? A line of subsequent work has explored this by introducing intermediate notions in which the learner must cover “dense” subsets of the target language[22, 19, 10, 23]。这些概念形成了生成和识别之间的任务层次结构，按照学习者必须涵盖的目标语言的程度进行分级。. These notions form a hierarchy of tasks between generation and identification, graded by how much of the target language the learner must cover.

然而，所有这些结果都有一个共同的假设：学习者可以访问整个交互历史记录——在每一轮，其输出取决于完整的样本All of these results, however, share a common assumption: the learner has access to the entire interaction history—at each round, its output depends on the full sampleStS_{t}，而现有的建筑很大程度上依赖于此。 这是两个方面的强有力的假设。实际上，它并不能反映人类或现代机器学习系统如何生成语言，因为两者都没有保留完整的“训练数据”。从理论上讲，它掩盖了一个基本问题：有多少关于过去的信息对于成功的一代实际上是必要的？这两个问题自然会激发研究有限记忆下的语言生成。, and existing constructions rely heavily on this. This is a strong assumption on two fronts. Practically, it does not reflect how humans or modern machine learning systems generate language, since neither retains its full “training data.” Theoretically, it obscures a basic question: how much information about the past is actually necessary for successful generation? Both concerns naturally motivate studying language generation under bounded memory.

有界内存限制在学习理论和理论计算机科学中有着悠久的历史。 例如，在学习理论中，它们出现在主动学习中Bounded-memory restrictions have a long history in learning theory and theoretical computer science. In learning theory, for instance, they appear in active learning[16]，估计, in estimation[38, 34, 35, 36]，以及在线学习, and in online learning[37, 31]。 与我们的环境最直接相关的是，有界记忆甚至已经通过某些迭代和增量识别模型进行了极限语言识别的研究，我们稍后将更详细地讨论这些模型. Most directly relevant to our setting, bounded memory has even been studied for language identification in the limit, through certain iterative and incremental identification models which we discuss in more detail later[27, 7]。 这些作品中反复出现的一个教训是，记忆的限制可以从质上改变可学习的内容。 这自然对语言生成提出了以下问题：. A recurring lesson from these works is that bounds on memory can qualitatively change what is learnable. This naturally raises the following question for language generation:

1.1.2 两种类型的记忆以及由此产生的模型Two Types of Memory and the Resulting Models

为了使这个问题变得精确，我们必须首先指定学习器可以从一轮到下一轮携带哪些信息。在无界内存模型中，学习器根据整个样本历史记录来调节其输出To make this question precise, we must first specify what information the learner can carry from one round to the next. In the unbounded-memory model, the learner conditions its output on the entire sample historyStS_{t}。一旦记忆受到限制，只有部分信息可以保存下来。 在这里，我们区分了两种概念上不同类型的信息。. Once memory is bounded, only some of this information can survive. Here, we separate two conceptually different types of information.

  1. 1.

    来自环境的信息：学习者可能会记住以前从对手的枚举中看到的例子。Information from the environment: The learner may remember previously seen examples from the adversary’s enumeration.

  2. 2.

    来自学习者过去行为的信息： 学习者可能会忘记它所看到的原始示例，但仍然通过之前的输出保留一些内部状态。Information from the learner’s past actions: A learner may forget the raw examples it has seen and still retain some internal state through its previous outputs.

凭借无限的记忆，第一种信息严格来说比第二种信息更强大：记住所有观察到的示例的学习者可以重建其过去的动作，而相同的动作序列可能来自许多不同的示例历史。 然而，由于记忆有限，这两种信息都很重要。过去的例子是关于目标语言的直接证据。相比之下，过去的输出是根据当时看到的整个历史计算出来的，因此存储过去的输出实际上是存储该历史的摘要。With unbounded memory, the first kind of information is strictly more powerful than the second: a learner that remembers all observed examples can reconstruct its past actions, while the same action sequence could have arisen from many different example histories. With limited memory, however, both kinds of information matter. Past examples are direct evidence about the target language. Past outputs, by contrast, were computed from the entire history seen at the time, so storing a past output is in effect storing a summary of that history.

为了隔离每种资源的贡献，我们分别研究它们。首先，我们考虑一个完全无记忆的学习器，它只对当前的示例做出“反应”（To isolate the contribution of each resource, we study them separately. First, we consider a fully memoryless learner that only “reacts” to the current example (Section˜1.1.3）。接下来，我们在过去的示例中添加有限内存的两种自然形式：最后一个的滑动窗口). Next, we add two natural forms of limited memory over past examples: a sliding window of the lastWW示例和缓冲区examples and a buffer ofbb学习者选择的例子。它们之间的对比（保留最近的示例与保留选定的示例）隔离了选择要记住的示例是否有意义（examples chosen by the learner. The contrast between them (keeping recent examples versus keeping chosen ones) isolates whether selecting which examples to remember is meaningful (Section˜1.1.4）。 最后，我们去掉对过去例子的记忆，只允许对过去输出进行最简单的记忆：学习者最近的猜测（). Finally, we strip away memory of past examples and allow only the simplest form of memory over past outputs: the learner’s most recent guess (Section˜1.1.5）。 最后一个模型也在迭代和增量识别文献中得到了广泛的研究). This last model has also been extensively studied in the iterative and incremental identification literature[27, 7].

滑动窗口和自适应缓冲区的对比有一个简单的解释。通过滑动窗口，攻击者可以在信息丰富的示例之间插入一长串无信息的示例，这样窗口就不会一次容纳多个信息示例。使用自适应缓冲区，这不是一个障碍，因为学习者可以在每个信息示例出现后保留它，无论以后发生什么。The contrast between the sliding window and the adaptive buffer has a simple explanation. With a sliding window, the adversary can insert long blocks of uninformative examples between informative ones, so that the window never holds more than one informative example at a time. With an adaptive buffer, this is not an obstacle as the learner can keep each informative example once it appears, regardless of what   later.

1.1.5 利用最后猜测记忆进行近似识别Approximate Identification with Last-Guess Memory

最后，我们转向识别，这是层次结构中最强大的任务。如上所述，我们关注最简单的记忆设置：学习者忘记所有观察到的例子，只记住最近的猜测。Finally, we turn to identification, the strongest task in the hierarchy. As outlined above, we focus on the simplest memory setting: the learner forgets all observed examples and remembers only its most recent guess.

开始于Starting from[27]长期以来，人们一直在研究这个问题，但结果大多是负面的。正如我们在, a long line of work has studied this problem, with largely negative results. As we show inProposition˜5.1，即使对于只有三种语言的集合，精确识别也可能失败。受这种阻碍的推动，我们考虑适度放松：, exact identification can fail even for collections of just three languages. Motivated by this obstruction, we consider a mild relaxation:近似识别approximate identification，学习者可能会收敛到一个不同于, where the learner may converge to a hypothesis that differs fromKK最多有限多个元素。虽然文献中已经考虑了这一概念的近似变体，但据我们所知，近似识别本身尚未被研究。令人惊讶的是，我们证明了所有有限集合的近似识别都是可能的：on at most finitely many elements. While close variants of this notion have been considered in the literature, to our best knowledge approximate identification itself has not been studied. Surprisingly, we show that approximate identification is possible for all finite collections:

定理1.3Theorem 1.3 （增量近似识别）(Incremental Approximate Identification).

所有有限集合都可以被学习器大致识别，该学习器只允许记住其最近的输出。All finite collections are approximately identifiable by a learner that is only allowed to remember its most recent output.

证明概述Proof overview of˜1.2.

这些结果是我们工作中技术性最强的部分。我们的证明都遵循相同的高级原则：在内存有限的情况下，生成器只能输出对于仍与当前可见信息一致的语言同时“安全”的集合，因此问题简化为了解这些安全区域有多大。在无记忆模型中，这会导致精确的 Sperner 型极小极大值；在滑动窗口模型中，修改后的结构表明有限窗口不会扩大最坏情况的安全区域；最后，在生成器可以存储的模型中These results are the most technically involved components of our work. Our proofs all follow the same high-level principle: with limited memory, the generator can only output sets that are simultaneously “safe” for the languages still consistent with the information currently visible, so the problem reduces to understanding how large those safe regions can be. In the memoryless model this leads to an exact Sperner-type minimax value; in the sliding-window model a modified construction shows that a finite window does not enlarge the worst-case safe region; finally, in the model where the generator can storebb根据其选择的示例，每个存储的示例都会永久缩小“歧义性”，并且通过选择存储哪些示例，生成器本质上可以将不确定性水平降低到与较小规模的集合相对应的水平。现在我们更详细地解释结果的三个部分。examples of its choice, each stored example permanently shrinks the “ambiguity,” and by choosing which examples to store the generator can, essentially, reduce the level of uncertainty to one corresponding to a collection of smaller size. We now explain each of the three parts of the result in more detail.

1.3 讨论和开放问题Discussion and Open Questions

在这项工作中，我们研究了内存限制的变体 语言生成受到限制。我们的结果展示了丰富的景观。当学习者被允许记住过去的例子而不是其过去的输出时，即使在最严格的记忆限制下，有限的生成也总是可能的。然而，获得非平凡的密度界限迫使我们关注有限集合。 相反，当学习者忘记过去的例子但只记得最后的猜测时，近似识别（识别的轻微放松）对于所有有限集合仍然是可以实现的，从而规避了经典的不可能性In this work we study variants of memory-bounded language generation in the limit. Our results show a rich landscape. When the learner is permitted to remember past examples but not its past outputs, generation in the limit is always possible, even under the most severe memory restriction. Obtaining non-trivial density bounds, however, forces us to focus on finite collections. Conversely, when the learner forgets past examples but remembers only its last guess, approximate identification – a mild relaxation of identification – remains achievable for all finite collections, circumventing the classical impossibility[27]。 这些结果强化了论文的主题之一：过去例子的记忆和过去输出的记忆是不同的资源，有限的记忆并不会让所有任务都变得更加困难。相反，这两种资源的实际效果是微妙的，并且取决于学习目标和保留的信息类型。. These results reinforce one of the main themes of the paper: memory of past examples and memory of past outputs are different resources, and bounded memory does not make all tasks uniformly harder. Rather, the actual effect of these two resources is subtle and depends both on the learning objective and on the type of information retained.

我们的工作中自然会出现一些问题。最直接的一个涉及有限记忆的近似识别。在没有内存限制的情况下，可以实现近似识别当且仅当There are several natural questions that arise from our work. The most immediate one concerns approximate identification with bounded memory. Without memory restrictions, approximate identification is achievable if and only ifℒ\euscr{L}满足弱安格鲁因条件satisfies the weak Angluin condition[10, 19]。当学习者只能记住之前的猜测时，相同的条件是否表征了近似识别，或者记忆限制是否施加了更强的障碍？ 我们还认为我们的结果是朝着放松语言生成模型的一些不切实际的方面迈出的一步，通过表明它对内存限制具有惊人的鲁棒性（. Does the same condition characterize approximate identification when the learner can only remember its previous guess, or does the memory restriction impose a stronger barrier? We also view our results as a step toward relaxing some of the unrealistic aspects of the language generation model, by showing that it is surprisingly robust to memory restrictions (Theorem˜1.1）。了解内存、计算或访问过去数据的哪些其他自然限制仍然允许生成所有可数集合将是很有趣的。). It would be interesting to understand which other natural restrictions on memory, computation, or access to past data still permit generation for all countable collections.

1.4 相关工作Related Work

我们的工作与两条研究方向最直接相关：最近关于极限语言生成的工作，以及关于有限内存限制下极限语言识别的旧文献。第一行提供了我们的论文所基于的生成框架，而第二行则激发了此处核心的内存限制观点。Our work is most directly related to two lines of research: recent work on language generation in the limit, and the older literature on language identification in the limit under bounded-memory restrictions. The first line provides the generation frameworks that our paper builds on, while the second motivates the memory-restricted viewpoint that is central here.

语言生成受到限制。Language generation in the limit.

我们在极限框架中进行语言生成工作We work in the language generation in the limit framework introduced by[24]。从那时起，越来越多的工作探索了许多附近的问题和变体，包括统一和非统一的生成概念、具有额外反馈的模型、更强的广度或密度概念、嘈杂或不完整的演示以及部分识别. Since then, a growing body of work has explored many nearby questions and variants, including uniform and non-uniform notions of generation, models with additional feedback, stronger notions of breadth or density, noisy or incomplete presentations, and partial identification[33, 18, 10, 32, 30, 22, 23, 15, 29, 9, 20, 11, 4, 1, 5, 19]。我们的侧重点不同。我们不是加强反馈模型或研究更广泛、更嘈杂或更强大的生成变体，而是关注学习者必须保留多少记忆才能生成。. Our emphasis is different. Rather than strengthening the feedback model or studying broader, noisier, or more robust variants of generation, we focus on how much memory a learner must retain in order to generate.

语言的生成受到广度或密度的限制。Language generation in the limit with breadth or density.

该文献的一个特别相关的子线研究了更强烈的生成概念，它要求学习者不仅产生有效的看不见的字符串，而且要通过某种广度或覆盖范围的概念来做到这一点。这个方向的动机是原始结果的一个基本特征A particularly relevant subline of this literature studies stronger notions of generation that require the learner not just to produce valid unseen strings, but to do so with some notion of breadth or coverage. This direction is motivated by a basic feature of the original result of[24]：虽然它们的生成器最终停止生成目标语言之外的字符串，但它可以通过从目标语言的越来越薄的子集生成来实现这一点。因此，后续的几项工作引入了更严格的要求，要求学习者生成更具代表性、更密集或更广泛的语言子集。事实证明，这些强化的概念比基本生成要困难得多，在许多情况下使任务接近识别: while their generator eventually stops producing strings outside the target language, it may do so by generating from an increasingly thin subset of the target. Several subsequent works therefore introduced stronger requirements that ask the learner to generate more representative, denser, or otherwise broader subsets of the language. These strengthened notions turn out to be substantially harder than basic generation, in many cases bringing the task close to identification[18, 10, 30, 22, 19, 23]。我们的工作与这个方向正交。我们保持生成的基本概念不变，而是研究当学习者的记忆受到严重限制时图片如何变化。. Our work is orthogonal to this direction. We keep the basic notion of generation fixed and instead study how the picture changes when the learner’s memory is severely restricted.

语言识别是在有限的记忆的限制下进行的。Language identification in the limit with bounded memory.

最接近的先前工作线研究极限内的增量或迭代学习，其中学习者仅使用先前的猜测和最新的示例来形成下一个猜测The closest prior line of work studies incremental, or iterative, learning in the limit, where the learner forms its next guess using only its previous guess and the newest example[7]。在我们的框架中，学习者忘记了所有过去的例子，只保留了当前猜测中编码的内容。这一领域的工作已经发展成为关于有限记忆识别的更广泛的文献，研究有限示例记忆和反馈学习等变体. In our framing, the learner forgets all past examples and retains only what is encoded in its current guess. This line of work has grown into a broader literature on bounded-memory identification, studying variants such as bounded example memory and feedback learning[7], 有限的长期记忆, limited long-term memory[21]，集合驱动和重排无关的限制, set-driven and rearrangement-independent restrictions[28]，以及临时或有序内存, and temporary or ordinal-bounded memory[17, 6]。 与全内存设置相比，先前的工作在这些有界内存模型下仅给出了有限的识别积极结果. In contrast with the full-memory setting, prior work gives only limited positive results for identification under these bounded-memory models[7, 21, 28]。事实上，正如我们在. Indeed, as we show inProposition˜5.1，只有三种语言的集合无法在此模型中识别。然而，令人惊讶的是，这种不可能很大程度上源于定义的严格性：, there is a collection of just three languages that cannot be identified in this model. Surprisingly, however, this impossibility largely stems from the strictness of the definition: asTheorem˜5.2表明，近似识别，学习者只需要收敛到与目标不同的语言shows, approximate identification, where the learner need only converge to a language differing from the targetKK在有限多个元素中，增量学习器对于每个有限集合都是可以实现的。in finitely many elements, is achievable for every finite collection by an incremental learner.

语言识别是在有限的记忆的限制下进行的。Language identification in the limit with bounded memory.

增量学习模型在有限的语言识别文献中得到了广泛的研究：在这里，学习者仅使用其先前的猜测和最新的例子来形成其下一个猜测The incremental learning model has been extensively studied in the literature on language identification in the limit: here, the learner forms its next guess using only its previous guess and the newest example[27, 7]。 还研究了该模型的几个变体。 其中包括有限记忆状态学习器，其中学习器从当前示例和辅助状态进行更新，该辅助状态可以将先前的猜测与其他有限信息一起编码. Several variants of this model have also been studied. These include bounded-memory-state learners, where the learner updates from the current example and an auxiliary state that can encode the previous guess together with other finite information[25];计数器变体，它保留增量学习模型，但除了当前示例和之前的猜测之外，还为学习者提供数字信号，例如当前轮数; counter variants, which keep the incremental learning model but also give the learner a numerical signal such as the current round number, in addition to the current example and previous guess[8, 26];以及以有限方式保留过去示例的模型，包括临时示例记忆，其中存储的示例如果不再出现，最终必须被忘记; and models that retain past examples in restricted ways, including temporary example memory, where stored examples must eventually be forgotten if they are not seen again[17]，序数有界示例内存，其中存储示例的扩展由序数值预算控制, ordinal-bounded example memory, where extensions of stored examples are controlled by an ordinal-valued budget[6]，以及相关的限制，例如有限的长期记忆和集合驱动或独立于重排的学习, and related restrictions such as limited long-term memory and set-driven or rearrangement-independent learning[21, 28]。 大部分文献将这些模型相互比较，确定哪些模型比哪些模型更强，哪些模型无可比拟。 我们的工作提出了一个不同的问题：有限内存限制如何影响生成、密度和识别的层次结构？ 我们的工作提出了一个不同的问题：有限内存限制如何影响生成、密度和识别的层次结构？ 一个中心主题是过去的示例和过去的输出表现为不同的资源： 对于固定数量的过去示例内存，我们的密度结果表明，有限集合的最佳极小极大保证随着集合的增长而恶化。 相比之下，在最后猜测的设置中，. Much of this literature compares these models to one another, establishing which are stronger than which and which are incomparable. Our work asks a different question: how do bounded-memory restrictions affect the hierarchy of generation, density, and identification? Our work asks a different question: how do bounded-memory restrictions affect the hierarchy of generation, density, and identification? A central theme is that past examples and past outputs behave as different resources: For a fixed amount of past-example memory, our density results show that the best minimax guarantee for finite collections deteriorates as the collection grows. By contrast, in the last-guess setting,Theorem˜5.2表明每个有限集合都可以被近似识别；最终的猜测仅在有限多个元素上与目标不同，因此目标中的密度为 1。shows that every finite collection can be approximately identified; the eventual guess differs from the target on only finitely many elements, and therefore has density one in the target.

并行且独立的工作：节省空间的发电Concurrent and independent work: space-efficient generation[13].

同时且独立地，Concurrently and independently,[13]也研究在资源限制下的语言生成。他们的工作与我们的工作无可比拟：他们将内存测量为流学习器使用的位数，并专注于由确定性有限自动机（DFA）识别的目标和假设语言，在有限字母表上具有有限数量的状态。 在这种情况下，它们描述了学习者使用的空间与学习者学习的目标假设“数量”之间的权衡。我们避免了对语言集合的自动机理论限制，而是以不同且更粗糙的方式对记忆进行建模：我们允许学习者仅保留有限数量的过去示例，或者仅保留其先前的猜测。因此，这两篇论文在不同的资源模型下提出了相同的广泛问题。also study language generation in the limit under resource constraints. Their work is incomparable with ours: They measure memory as the number of bits used by a streaming learner, and focus on target and hypothesis languages recognized by deterministic finite automata (DFA) with a bounded number of states over a finite alphabet. In that setting, they characterize tradeoffs between space used by the learner and the “amount” of the target hypothesis learned by the learner. We avoid automata-theoretic restrictions on the collection of languages, but model memory in a different and coarser way: we allow the learner to only retain a bounded number of past examples, or only its previous guess. Thus, the two papers ask the same broad question under different resource models.

4 内存有限的生成器的密度界限Density Bounds for Generators with Limited Memory

在本节中，我们研究具有有限内存的生成器的密度保证。极限生成只要求输出最终以目标语言表示；密度还询问这些输出覆盖目标语言的哪一部分。 我们始终使用基于集合的生成器，除非另有说明，否则我们继续假设有限重复枚举In this section we study density guarantees for generators with bounded memory. Generation in the limit asks only that outputs eventually lie in the target language; density additionally asks what fraction of the target language those outputs cover. We work throughout with set-based generators, and unless stated otherwise we continue to assume finitely repeating enumerations in the sense ofDefinition˜6.

第一个问题是生成器可以保留有关过去示例的哪些信息。 我们比较了三种模型：无记忆模型（也在上一节中研究过）、最近示例的滑动窗口以及学习者选择的示例的自适应缓冲区。The first question is what information about past examples the generator is allowed to retain. We compare three models: the memoryless model (which was also studied in the previous section), a sliding window of recent examples, and an adaptive buffer of examples chosen by the learner.

With no memory of past examples, such a generator cannot distinguish target languages that share the current example. 让LetSS是一个大小有限的集合be a finite set of sizenn，并让, and let𝒫​(𝒮)\euscr{P}(S)为其幂集。反链是一个子集合be its power set. The maximum possible size of an antichain in𝒫​(𝒮)\euscr{P}(S)正是is exactly(n⌊n/2⌋)\binom{n}{\left\lfloor n/2\right\rfloor}.

事实 4.6Fact 4.6 （对称链分解(Symmetric Chain Decomposition[12]).

让LetSS是一个大小有限的集合be a finite set of sizenn。一条链子在. A chain in𝒫​(𝒮)\euscr{P}(S)是严格递增子集的序列is a sequence of strictly increasing subsetsC1⊂C2⊂⋯⊂CmC_{1}\subset C_{2}\subset\dots\subset C_{m}。布尔格. 我们现在证明，对于无记忆的基于集合的生成器，有限集合上可实现的上限密度完全受斯佩纳界限控制。我们首先证明对手总是可以迫使上层密度下降到这个界限。We now show that for memoryless set-based generators, the achievable upper density on finite collections is entirely governed by the Sperner bound. 5 认同最后的猜测：增量学习Identification with Last Guess: Incremental Learning

在本节中，我们研究最后猜测记忆下的识别。 在这里，学习器忘记了所有过去的例子，只保留了之前的输出。 这是由正数据模型引入的经典增量学习In this section we study identification under last-guess memory. Here, the learner forgets all past examples and retains only its previous output. This is the classical incremental learning from positive data model introduced by[27]。 它将第二个内存资源与介绍隔离开来：过去的输出而不是过去的示例。 前面的部分研究了当生成器只能保留有关过去示例的有限信息时，仍保留什么生成和密度保证。 在这里，我们问当学习者仅保留其最近的猜测时，生成和识别保证仍然存在。. It isolates the second memory resource from the introduction: past outputs rather than past examples. The previous sections studied what generation and density guarantees remain when a generator can retain only limited information about past examples. Here we ask what generation and identification guarantees remain when the learner retains only its most recent guess.

定义13Definition 13 （增量学习者）(Incremental learner).

修复输出空间Fix an output spaceΩ\Omega和初始输出and an initial outputω0∈Ω\omega_{0}\in\Omega。具有输出空间的增量学习器. An incremental learner with output spaceΩ\Omega是一个确定性更新函数is a deterministic update function𝒜:Ω×𝒳→Ω\mathpzc{A}:\Omega\times\euscr{X}\to\Omega。 给定一个枚举. 与前面的部分一样，输出空间的选择决定了我们获得的模型类型。我们这里重点关注基于索引的标识设置：As in the earlier sections, the choice of output space determines the kind of model we obtain. We focus here on the index-based identification setting:Ω={1,…,N}\Omega=\left\{1,\dots,N\right\}对于有限集合for a finite collectionℒ={ℒ1,…,ℒ𝒩}\euscr{L}=\left\{L_{1},\dots,L_{N}\right\}, 或, orΩ=ℕ\Omega=\mathbb{N}对于可数集合，带有输出for a countable collection, with outputiti_{t}解释为假设语言interpreted as the hypothesis languageLitL_{i_{t}}。对于有限集合，这意味着学习器在集合之外没有额外的内部状态、同义词索引或假设；它唯一的持久状态是之前的输出. For finite collections, this means the learner has no extra internal states, synonym indices, or hypotheses outside the collection; its only persistent state is the previous output in{1,…,N}\left\{1,\dots,N\right\}.

从概念上讲，增量模型比（全信息）识别模型受到更多限制。Conceptually, the incremental model is more restricted than the (full-information) identification model of[14]，它检查整个样本历史记录。同时，它比无记忆学习器更强：增量学习器可以根据其先前的输出对相同的当前示例做出不同的反应。 鉴于这种优势，人们可能会问在该模型中是否可以进行识别。, which inspects the entire sample history. At the same time, it is stronger than a memoryless learner: an incremental learner can react differently to the same current example depending on its previous output. Given this strength, one might ask if identification becomes possible in this model.

我们的第一个观察结果是，即使对于非常小的集合，精确识别在增量模型中仍然很脆弱。Our first observation is that exact identification remains fragile in the incremental model, even for very small collections.

命题5.1Proposition 5.1 （即使是三种语言也没有确切的标识）(No exact identification even for three languages).

存在三种无限语言的集合，在任意正枚举下，任何基于增量索引的学习器都无法在极限范围内识别它们；事实上，对于有限重复枚举来说，这种不可能性已经成立。There exists a collection of three infinite languages that is not identifiable in the limit by any incremental index-based learner under arbitrary positive enumerations; indeed, the impossibility already holds for finitely repeating enumerations.

证明出现在The proof appears inSection˜5.1.

考虑到这种不可能的结果，我们转向在极限内自然放松语言识别：我们不要求学习者收敛到目标语言的确切身份，而是只要求它收敛到与目标语言最多在有限多个元素上不同的语言。由于集合中的每种语言都是无限的，因此两种仅在有限多个元素上不同的语言在所有元素上都一致，除了元素的消失部分。 因此，学习者基本上已经掌握了所有的目标语言，即使它没有准确地指出它。 特别是，近似识别保证了上一节中研究的所有密度概念（Given this impossibility result, we turn to a natural relaxation of language identification in the limit: instead of requiring the learner to converge to the exact identity of the target language, we ask only that it converge to a language that differs from the target on at most finitely many elements. Since every language in the collection is infinite, two languages that differ on finitely many elements agree on all but a vanishing fraction of their elements. The learner has therefore captured essentially all of the target language, even if it has not pinpointed it exactly. In particular, approximate identification guarantees that all notions of density studied in the previous section (Section˜4) 取最优值) take the optimal value11，因此，它明显强于生成器密度的下限。, and, hence, it is significantly stronger than lower bounding the generator’s density.

我们通过以下几乎包含的概念将近似识别形式化。We formalize approximate identification through the following notion of almost-containment.

让Letℒ={ℒ1,…,ℒ𝒩}\euscr{L}=\left\{L_{1},\dots,L_{N}\right\}, 让, letK∈ℒK\in\euscr{L}，并让, and let(it)t∈ℕ\left(i_{t}\right)_{t\in\mathbb{N}}是基于增量索引的学习器的枚举的输出be the outputs of an incremental index-based learner on an enumeration ofKK。我们说学习者大约识别. 作为一个具体的类比，想象一下从示例中学习 C 等成熟的编程语言。最终人们知道如何编写普通的 C 程序以及所有某些过时或异常的极端情况。这样的学习者并没有准确地识别出该语言，但已经学会了几乎所有的语言。 这正是上述近似识别定义想要捕捉的学习者类型。As a concrete analogy, imagine learning a mature programming language such as C from examples. Eventually one knows how to write ordinary C programs and all certain obsolete or exceptional corner cases. Such a learner has not identified the language exactly, but has learned almost all of it. This is precisely the kind of the learners the above definition of approximate identification intends to capture.

我们增量设置的主要结果表明，对于有限集合来说，这个宽松的目标总是可以实现的。Our main result for the incremental setting shows that this relaxed goal is always achievable for finite collections.

定理5.2Theorem 5.2 （有限集合的近似识别）(Approximate identification for finite collections).

无限语言的每个有限集合都可以由基于增量索引的学习器在极限范围内大致识别。Every finite collection of infinite languages is approximately identifiable in the limit by an incremental index-based learner.

Theorem˜5.2形成鲜明对比stands in sharp contrast toProposition˜5.1：同时: whileProposition˜5.1表明对于大小为 3 的集合，精确识别可能已经失败，shows that exact identification can fail already for a collection of size three,Theorem˜5.2表明对于每个有限集合，近似识别都是成功的。shows that approximate identification succeeds for every finite collection.

这一结果还给出了记住过去的例子和过去的输出的能力之间的对比的正式版本。 如图所示This result also gives one formal version of the contrast between the power of remembering past examples and past outputs. As shown inSection˜4，通过对过去示例的记忆，无论生成器记住的示例数量有多少，有限集合的最佳极小极大密度保证都会随着集合大小而恶化。 相比之下，即使是最后一次猜测的记忆，也足以实现对每个有限集合的近似识别，因此，无论有限集合的大小如何，也足以实现最佳密度。, with memory of past examples, the best minimax density guarantee for finite collections deteriorates with the collection size no matter the number of examples the generator remembers. In contrast, with memory of even the last guess, already suffices for enabling approximate identification of every finite collection and, hence, also for aching the optimal density regardless of the finite collection’s size.

人们很自然地会问哪些超出有限情况的集合允许增量学习者进行近似识别。同样的论点也适用于许多可数族，前提是严格的几乎包含关系允许适当的拓扑排序，其中每种目标语言仅具有有限多个前身。在另一个极端，如果一个集合违反了由It is also natural to ask which collections beyond the finite case admit approximate identification by incremental learners. The same argument extends to many countable families, provided the strict almost-containment relation admits a suitable topological ordering in which every target language has only finitely many predecessors. At the opposite extreme, if a collection violates the weak Angluin condition introduced by[10, 19]，那么即使是全信息学习者也无法大致识别它，因此也不能被增量学习者识别。, then it is not approximately identifiable even by a full-information learner, and hence not by an incremental one either.

6 结论Conclusion

在本文中，我们研究有界记忆如何在极限内改变生成、密度和识别的层次结构。我们证明了基本的生成保证对于内存限制具有惊人的鲁棒性。In this paper, we study how bounded memory changes the hierarchy of generation, density, and identification in the limit. We show that the basic generation guarantee is surprisingly robust to memory restrictions.Theorem˜1.1延长了保证extends the guarantees of[24]到无记忆设置：在有限重复枚举的温和假设下，每个可数集合都承认一个无记忆的基于集合的生成器。此外，对于有限的内存来说，需要有限的重复（to the memoryless setting: under the mild assumption of finitely-repeating enumerations, every countable collection admits a memoryless set-based generator. Moreover, requiring finite repetitions is necessary with bounded memory (Theorem˜3.1），尽管当学习者拥有无限的记忆力时，这并不重要。), though it is immaterial when the learner has unbounded memory.

接下来，我们转向实现密度的更强烈要求。这里的情况更加微妙：无记忆生成器承认正极小极大上密度（Next, we turn to the stronger requirement of achieving density. Here the picture is more nuanced: memoryless generators admit a positive minimax upper density (Theorem˜4.1），但一旦集合至少有三种语言（) but no positive lower density once the collection has at least three languages (Theorem˜4.2）。 然后我们询问为生成器提供更多过去示例的内存是否可以改善图像。改进是有限的：任何有限长度的滑动窗口根本没有改进（). We then ask whether giving the generator more memory of past examples improves the picture. The improvement is limited: a sliding window of any finite length gives no improvement at all (Theorem˜4.10），而自适应缓冲区确实可以在示例出现后保留信息丰富的示例（), while an adaptive buffer does help by preserving informative examples once they appear (Theorem˜4.15).

到目前为止，我们考虑的记忆模型都涉及过去的例子——不保留任何一个，最近的几个，或者一个自选的子集。在本文的最后部分，我们转向不同的资源：学习者只记住以前的输出，而不是过去的例子。这里情况发生了很大的变化。虽然The memory models we have considered so far all involve past examples — keeping none of them, the most recent few, or a self-chosen subset. In the final part of the paper, we turn to a different resource: rather than past examples, the learner remembers only its previous output. Here the picture changes substantially. AlthoughProposition˜5.1表明即使对于三种语言的集合，精确识别也可能失败，shows that exact identification can fail even for a collection of three languages,Theorem˜5.2表明学习者仅记住最近的猜测就可以大致识别任何有限集合。由于近似识别给出了密度shows that a learner remembering only its most recent guess can approximately identify any finite collection. Since approximate identification gives density11在此处考虑的所有密度概念下的目标中，仅记住先前的猜测就足以满足密度in the target under all the density notions considered here, remembering only the previous guess suffices for density11在每个有限集合上（on every finite collection (Theorem˜4.15）——没有固定数量的滑动窗口内存可以做到的事情。 因此，所使用的内存类型比内存数量更重要。) — something no fixed amount of sliding-window memory can do. Hence, the type of memory used can matter more than the amount.

这些结果留下了几个方向。一是描述可数集合，这些集合可以用最后猜测的记忆大致识别。另一个是了解实现有界内存生成器需要对集合进行哪些访问：我们的构造假设算法可以完全访问集合，但仍不清楚哪些预言、计算或表示假设保留了相同的保证。These results leave several directions open. One is to characterize the countable collections that are approximately identifiable with last-guess memory. Another is to understand what access to the collection is needed to implement bounded-memory generators: our constructions assume the algorithm has full access to the collection, and it remains unclear which oracle, computational, or representation assumptions preserve the same guarantees.

附录AAppendix A增量生成的进一步结果Further Results on Incremental Generation

在本节中，我们继续讨论增量模型。 我们首先证明，对于仅三种语言的集合，精确识别和精确基于索引的生成都可能失败（In this section, we continue our discussion of the incremental model. We first show that exact identification and exact index-based generation can both fail for a collection of just three languages (Section˜A.1）。 然后，我们证明这种限制特定于基于索引的输出：一旦允许生成器输出域的元素，之前的输出可以作为编码整个交互历史的代码字，有效地将增量模型还原回全信息设置（). We then show that this limitation is specific to index-based output: once the generator is allowed to output elements of the domain, the previous output can serve as a codeword that encodes the entire interaction history, effectively reducing the incremental model back to the full-information setting (Section˜A.2）。 结合这些想法，我们获得了每个有限集合的基于增量元素的生成的积极结果（). Combining these ideas, we obtain a positive result for incremental element-based generation of every finite collection (Section˜A.3).

A.1 三种语言已经妨碍了准确识别Three Languages Already Prevent Exact Identification

我们首先表明，即使对于非常小的集合，增量模型中的精确识别也可能会失败。We begin by showing that exact identification in the incremental model can fail even for very small collections.

定理A.1Theorem A.1.

存在三种无限语言的集合，任何基于增量索引的学习器都无法在限制范围内识别它们。There exists a collection of three infinite languages that is not identifiable in the limit by any incremental index-based learner.

请注意，任何最终稳定到正确索引的基于增量索引的学习器也可以成功地作为同一集合的基于增量索引的生成器，因此不可能生成意味着不可能进行识别。 我们证明了以下关于生成的更强的结果。Note that any incremental index-based learner that eventually stabilizes to the correct index also succeeds as an incremental index-based generator for the same collection, so an impossibility for generation implies an impossibility for identification. We prove the following stronger result about generation.

A.2 基于元素的生成可以通过编码模拟无限内存Element-Based Generation Can Simulate Infinite Memory via Coding

不可能的事在The impossibility inProposition˜A.2关键依赖于这样一个事实：输出是有限集的索引relies crucially on the fact that the output is an index from a finite set[N][N]。 一个索引最多携带. An index carries at mostlog⁡N\log{N}位，因此在每一轮之后，生成器仅保留有关过去的有限数量的信息。 （请注意，正如我们在bits, so after each round the generator retains only a bounded amount of information about the past. (Note that, as we showed inTheorem˜5.2，如果稍微放宽识别要求以允许有限数量的“错误”，那么令人惊讶的是, if one relaxes the requirement of identification slightly to allow for a finite number of “errors,” then surprisingly thelog⁡N\log{N}从索引中保留的位就足够了。）bits retained from the indices are sufficient.)

一旦允许生成器输出域的元素，情况就会完全改变The situation changes completely once the generator is allowed to output an element of the domain𝒳\euscr{X}。关键的观察是，先前的输出在下一轮中被反馈到生成器，并且. The key observation is that the previous output is fed back to the generator at the next round, and an element of𝒳\euscr{X}可以编码任意长的字符串。因此，生成器可以使用其输出作为码字：它将整个观察到的前缀的描述嵌入到输出元素的标识中，并且在下一轮中，它在选择新的码字之前解码该描述。通过这种方式，单个输出元素可以携带足够的信息来模拟全信息学习器，并且有界内存限制有效地崩溃。 从有限记忆学习的角度来看，这是不可取的：模型不再限制各轮保留的信息量，而只是将该信息隐藏在最后输出的表示中。因此，明显的“记忆限制”很大程度上是输出格式的产物，而不是对学习者的真正限制，这就是我们不进一步研究该模型的原因。can encode an arbitrarily long string. The generator can therefore use its output as a codeword: it embeds a description of the entire observed prefix into the identity of the output element, and at the next round it decodes this description before choosing a new codeword. In this way, a single output element can carry enough information to simulate a full-information learner, and the bounded-memory restriction effectively collapses. From the perspective of bounded-memory learning, this is undesirable: the model no longer limits how much information is retained across rounds, but only hides that information inside the representation of the last output. The apparent “memory bound” is therefore largely an artifact of the output format rather than a genuine restriction on the learner, which is why we do not study this model further.

The identity of the subset encodes the current hypothesis or hidden state, while the position of the output within that subset encodes any additional finite information, including the entire observed prefix. Thus the previous output serves as an unbounded storage device for the past (which is, as we mentioned, undesirable).

总而言之，To summarize,Theorem˜A.4表明任何假设最终几乎包含在目标中的全信息学习器都可以编译成基于增量元素的生成器。编译之所以有效，是因为每个输出元素都编码了完整的交互历史记录，允许增量生成器逐步模拟全信息学习器。shows that any full-information learner whose hypotheses are eventually almost contained in the target can be compiled into an incremental element-based generator. The compilation works because each output element encodes the full interaction history, allowing the incremental generator to simulate the full-information learner step by step.

A.3 为一代人带来积极成果A Positive Result for Generation

我们现在结合编码编译We now combine the coding compilation ofTheorem˜A.4根据近似辨识定理with the approximate-identification theorem fromSection˜5获得用于有限集合的基于增量元素的生成器。to obtain an incremental element-based generator for finite collections.

应谨慎解释此结果：这是可能的，因为基于元素的生成器可以在其最后一个操作中编码任意大量的信息。 因此，虽然结果是肯定的，但它并不能有意义地反映有界内存算法的强度，因此我们不会进一步探索可以进一步获取最后猜测的基于元素的生成器。This result should be interpreted with caution: it is possible only because element-based generators can encode arbitrarily large amounts of information in their last action. Thus, while the result is positive, it does not meaningfully reflect the strength of bounded-memory algorithms, and for this reason we do not explore element-based generators which have access to their last guess further.
